notes.title: Linux Update
notes.content:
With the recent release of Game Maker Studio 2.3, Linux build support was finally fixed. The new patch for Beardy McStrongarm updates the Linux version of the game.

These updates include:
[list]
[*]Performance Improvements
[*]Bug Fixes
[*]Updated menu screen for Fullscreen/Window switching
[/list]

Thanks for playing Beardy McStrongarm,

Blekoh
